notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
An opponent is unable to block Skullsnatcher.
Skullsnatcher does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Skullsnatcher as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Skullsnatcher to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Dockside Extortionist.
Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate at least three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {1}{U}{B}.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Sakashim'a Student to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
